description: Painted backdrop for a window view: the far side of a quiet 1880s town street (a terrace of brick and stucco town houses with sash windows, railings, pavement and cobbles under an overcast sky), 24 x 12 m, one flat picture. Front -Y; origin at the middle of the bottom edge. Stand it a street's width outside a window, facing the window, its bottom below the outside ground line.
